i.norm: Verifies that {@link TaiInstant#ofTaiSeconds(long, long)} normalises a negative nanosecond adjustment into the valid 0..999,999,999 range by borrowing one second, and that two instances built from identical inputs are equal.
A nano adjustment of -3113 is below zero, so the factory borrows one second: seconds become -3113 - 1 = -3114, and the nanos wrap to 1_000_000_000 - 3113 = 999_996_887.
